audit_items.proof_trace: `initialize` unconditionally calls `_verifyValidParams` (L62) before storing the key (L68); `_verifyValidParams` calls `ECIES.isValid(publicKey)` and reverts on failure. `ECIES.isValid` enforces the full alt_bn128 curve equation (y²≡x³+3 mod p), field-bound checks (x,y < FIELD_MODULUS), and excludes the identity and generator points—making the guard both necessary and sufficient. The BN128 cofactor h=1 means every valid curve point is already in the prime-order subgroup, so no separate subgroup check is needed.
